document.querySelectorAll('.home-pulse,.home-ritual,.home-hero,.screen-enter').forEach(el=>{el.style.animation='none';el.style.opacity='1';el.style.transform='none';}); window.scrollTo(0,0); const sm=document.querySelector('.home-pulse--sport')?.dataset?.sportMonthKey; const em=document.querySelector('.home-pulse--craft')?.dataset?.monthKey; 'freeze month sport='+(sm||'?')+' express='+(em||'?')

document.querySelector('.home-pulse--sport')?.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'}); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); (document.querySelector('.home-pulse--sport .home-pulse__mark.is-hot')||document.querySelector('.home-pulse--sport .home-pulse__phrase-btn'))?.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 450)); 'sport-tip'

for (let i=0;i<45;i++){ if (document.querySelector('#toExpress') && !document.querySelector('.day-flow--wait')) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); } document.querySelector('#toExpress') ? 'day-ready' : 'day-timeout'

for (let i=0;i<60;i++){ if (document.querySelector('#shop-checklist')) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); } if(!document.querySelector('#shop-checklist')){ location.hash='#/shop'; for (let i=0;i<40;i++){ if (document.querySelector('#shop-checklist')) break; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); } } document.querySelector('#shop-checklist')?'shop-ok':'shop-fail'

window.scrollTo(0,0); document.querySelector('.shop-progress, .shop-checkout-header')?.scrollIntoView({block:'start'}); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); 'wallet'

const isOver=()=>!!document.querySelector('.shop-progress--over'); const settle=async()=>{ await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,380)); const v=document.querySelector('.ui-busy-veil'); if(v&&!v.hidden){v.hidden=true; document.querySelector('.phone')?.classList.remove('is-busy-veil');} }; const minus=document.querySelector('.sku--ok [data-qty-delta="-1"]')||document.querySelector('[data-qty-delta="-1"]'); if(minus){ minus.click(); await settle(); } let n=0; while(isOver() && n<18){ const boxes=[...document.querySelectorAll('input[data-ok]:checked')]; const last=boxes[boxes.length-1]; if(!last) break; last.click(); await settle(); n++; } 'trim over='+isOver()+' unchecked='+n+' ok='+[...document.querySelectorAll('input[data-ok]:checked')].length
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400)); document.querySelector('.sku--ok')?.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); 'qty-settle'

document.getElementById('toast-host') && (document.getElementById('toast-host').innerHTML=''); document.querySelector('#shop-sport-handoff-dismiss')?.click(); document.querySelectorAll('.shop-sport-handoff').forEach(el=>el.remove()); document.querySelector('#print')?.scrollIntoView({block:'end'}); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 450)); const v=document.querySelector('.ui-busy-veil'); if(v&&!v.hidden){v.hidden=true; document.querySelector('.phone')?.classList.remove('is-busy-veil');} 'dock-clean'
